end of period to search with

indices of bounding time values within Timelist

When true turns on a kluge for an inconsistency which may occur in a special case. When the modulo time period (i.e. Time_end - Time_beg) is a whole number of years and is not a multiple of 4, and the calendar in use has leap years, then it is likely that the interpolation will involve mapping a common year onto a leap year. In this case it is often desirable, but not absolutely necessary, to use data for Feb 28 of the leap year when it is mapped onto a common year.
